name: Instagram Vintage Filter
summary: A phone photo in a square 1:1 frame with a one-tap filter: warm fade, lifted blacks, a dark vignette and a thick white border. It made a phone snapshot look like an old print.

philosophy.core_thesis: One tap turns a plain phone snapshot into a keepsake: the filter, the frame and the vignette supply the age that the photo does not have.
design_principles: Crop every photo to a 1:1 square and show it at full width, 640px on the first apps.
Fade the blacks to 10% to 15% grey and push the highlights toward amber (#E8B866) at 20% to 30% strength.
Add a vignette: a radial dark edge from 55% radius out to 100%, at 35% to 55% opacity.
Put a white border of 24px to 40px around the photo, with a thicker bottom edge of 64px for the caption.
Offer 15 to 18 named filters in a strip of 80px thumbnails, each with a one-word name in capitals.
Set the caption in a plain grotesque at 14px with the user name in bold, and keep the chrome flat.
Show a 1px hairline between the photo cards in the feed and a 44px tab bar of 5 icons.
anti_patterns: Cool, clean, neutral colour with no fade
A thin edge with no frame
Many filters stacked on one photo
Hard black shadows with no lift
Large decorative display type on the photo

layout.grid_mechanics: A single column of square cards 640px wide; the photo is 1:1 and the caption sits in a 64px strip below it.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 15% to 20% of the surface is border and gap; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 16 and 32px.
layout.alignment_rules: Photos fill the column; user name and time align flush left at 12px from the edge.
layout.container_geometry: Square photos with a 2px to 6px radius, a white print border and a 1px hairline between cards.

font_pairings.note: An open look-alike of Helvetica for the app chrome; Arimo has the same metrics.
A hand-written face for a print-style caption under the photo.
A typewriter face for a date stamp on the border.

typography.tracking: Display takes 0.02em; filter names take +0.08em in capitals.
hierarchy_rules: Set filter names in capitals at 11px.
Set the user name in bold and the caption in regular.

color.palette_structure: Warm cream and sepia on a dark brown vignette, with one amber wash and one faded teal.
color.contrast_rules: Text on cream holds at least 12:1; amber and teal carry filter tints and links only.
color.surface_treatment: Flat cream and paper fills; the photo carries the colour grade; a 1px #D9CBB0 hairline separates cards.
color.light_and_shadow: A radial vignette of 35% to 55% opacity on the photo; the chrome has no cast shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: An instant print: a cream border around a faded, warm square photo.
materiality.border_rules: A 24px to 40px white border on the photo; a 1px hairline on cards.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur on chrome; a 1px lower edge of #D9CBB0 lifts the card.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline icons at 24px with a 2px stroke and round ends: heart, comment, camera and a filter wand.
ornamentation_details.illustration: No drawn art; the photo is the image. A small camera logo in the header.

motion.transition_physics: The filter strip slides at 240ms; a tapped filter cross-fades the grade over 180ms; the heart pops to 120% and back in 300ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Active filter thumbnail gets a 2px amber ring; a double tap on the photo shows a white heart that scales from 0 to 110% in 400ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a warm, sentimental pull, as if the moment is already a memory.

avoid_when: The photo must show true colour, such as product or medical images.
The design needs a modern, flat, wide-format layout.
The audience wants a clean editorial look.

modifiers.how: Reduce the fade to 5%, drop the vignette and the white border, and set a matte grade.
Darken the ground, add pink and sage tints and a light grain, and remove the white frame.
Apply one tone to all photos and show them in a 3-column grid with 2px gaps.

pack.why: A line family that matches the thin, round app icons of the first photo apps.

ground.why: The ground is the white print border: a frame around a square photo.
